author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this thought-provoking TEDx talk, technologist Joanna Montgomery explores how our obsession with optimisation and technology is changing the way we love and connect. Joanna examines our obsession with hacking and optimising everything, from sleep and exercise to love itself. She asks whether this drive for efficiency is eroding the magic in our relationships. Through compelling insights, she invites us to consider what happens when efficiency replaces empathy, and emotions become problems to solve rather than experiences to feel. 

Joanna Montgomery is a technologist and entrepreneur. At University she created the first internet-connected product for human connection across distance, and subsequently built a business from that. Her work sits at the intersection of technology and human connection and explores how they can work together but recognise where the limits are.
